y-m-49-02.title: Tinogona kutaura 'ichokwadi' mushure mokutarisa mienzaniso mishoma here?
y-m-49-02.topic: Chirevo necontrapositive yacho (hwaro hwokutonga chokwadi kana kwete)
y-m-49-02.goal: Tsvaga kuti 'kutarisa mienzaniso mishoma' hakugoni kuva hwaro hwokutonga chokwadi necontrapositive, uye gadzira iwe pachako nhamba yakazara x inoratidza kuti chirevo hachisi chechokwadi.
y-m-49-02.material:
Chirevo R pamusoro penhamba chaiyo x: 'Kana x²>4, saka x>2.' (Kana x sikweya yakakura kupfuura 4, saka x yakakura kupfuura 2.)
Mina akanyora zvinotevera achishandisa contrapositive kutsvaga kana R ichokwadi. Chirevo chekutanga necontrapositive yacho zvinogara zvine kukosha kwechokwadi kwakafanana.

y-m-49-02.s.s1.line.2: Kuisa x=2, x=1, x=0 kunopa x² ye 4, 1, 0, zvose 4 kana shoma, saka contrapositive ichokwadi.

y-m-49-09.title: Kana tichiziva kuti 'kana p saka q' i yenhema chete
y-m-49-09.topic: Converse, inverse, ne contrapositive ye proposition (chii chakasimbiswa uye chii chisina kusimbiswa kubva pa proposition yenhema)
y-m-49-09.goal: Ronga kana chokwadi che contrapositive, converse, ne inverse chimwe nechimwe chakasimbiswa neruzivo rwekuti 'kana p saka q' i yenhema chete, uye ugadzire zviitiko apo converse i yechokwadi nekana i yenhema uchishandisa mamiriro e interval.
y-m-49-09.material:
Pamamiriro maviri p ne q, zvatinoziva chete i kuti proposition 'proposition X: kana p saka q' i yenhema, uye hatisati taziva kuti p ne q i mamiriro emhando ipi.
Converse i 'kana q saka p', inverse i 'kana isiri p saka isiri q', uye contrapositive i 'kana isiri q saka isiri p'. Fungidzira kuti wakatodzidza kuti proposition ne contrapositive yayo dzinogara dzine truth value imwechete.
y-m-49-09.prereq.1: Matsananguro e converse, inverse, ne contrapositive ye proposition
y-m-49-09.prereq.2: Ma truth sets emamiriro akapiwa se ma intervals nehukama hwe subset ('kana p saka q' i yechokwadi ⇔ P⊂Q)
y-m-49-09.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza zvirevo zvese zvatinogona kutaura kuti zvinogara zvichishanda kubva paruzivo rwekuti proposition X i yenhema chete.
y-m-49-09.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora converse ne inverse padivi pedivi uchishandisa 'q, p, not', uye ugadzire contrapositive yeimwe uye uienzanise neimwe.
y-m-49-09.s.s1.hint.1: Funga muenzaniso mumwe chaiwo apo proposition yekutanga i yenhema uye utarise kuti converse ne inverse zvakadini mumuenzaniso iwoyo.
y-m-49-09.s.s1.r.a: Iyi i sarudzo yakaratidza property yekuti proposition yekutanga ne contrapositive yayo dzinogara dzine truth value imwechete.

y-m-49-06.title: Humboo hwakanyorwa nevadzidzi vana: kunyora kupi kwakaratidza S?
y-m-49-06.topic: Umboo hwechirevo (umboo ne contrapositive, umboo ne contradiction, nekuzviparadzanisa ne converse)
y-m-49-06.goal: Rongedza kuti kunyora kupi kwemana kunogamuchirwa seumboo, uye utsanangure kuti kunyora kune hypothesis ne conclusion yakatsiviwa kunoratidza chii.
y-m-49-06.material:
Chirevo S nezve natural numbers a ne b: 'Kana ab iri odd, saka a ne b zvose ndema odd.'
Vadzidzi vana vakanyora imwe neimwe kuti vakaratidza S.
가: Kana a=3, b=5, saka ab=15 ndi odd, uye a ne b zvose ndema odd. Kana a=7, b=9, saka ab=63 ndi odd, uye zvose ndema odd. Saka S ndeye chokwadi.
나: Fungidzira kuti imwe chete kana kupfuura ye a ne b ndi even. Kana tikadaidza even iyoyo 2k (k ndi natural number), saka ab ine 2k sefactor, saka ndi even. Saka kana ab iri odd, saka a ne b zvose ndema odd.
다: Fungidzira kuti a ne b zvose ndema odd. Kana a=2m+1 ne b=2n+1 (m ne n ndema integers ari 0 kana kupfuura), saka ab=4mn+2m+2n+1=2(2mn+m+n)+1, saka ndi odd. Saka S yaratidzwa.
라: Fungidzira kuti ab ndi odd uye a ndi even. Kana a=2k, saka ab=2kb ndi even. Izvi zvinopokana nefungidziro yekuti ab ndi odd, saka a ndi odd. b ndi odd nenzira imwe chete.
y-m-49-06.prereq.1: Kunyora even number muchimiro che 2k ne odd number muchimiro che 2k+1 (k ndi integer)
y-m-49-06.prereq.2: Zvinoreva kuratidza ne contrapositive nene contradiction
y-m-49-06.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza zvose zvinyorwa zvinogona kugamuchirwa sekuratidza S.
y-m-49-06.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora kuti chinyorwa chimwe nechimwe chinotangira papi (chinofungidzira chii).
y-m-49-06.s.s1.hint.1: S chirevo chinofungidzira 'ab ndi odd'. Paradzanisa zvinyorwa kuita zvine fungidziro imwe chete nezvine fungidziro yakasiyana.
y-m-49-06.s.s1.r.a: Kushanda mumienzaniso mishoma hakugoni kuratidza chirevo chenezve 'natural numbers a, b dzose'. Tarisa kana pane logic yakajairika isiri mienzaniso.
y-m-49-06.s.s1.r.b: Iyi isarudzo yakaratidza kuti nei chinyorwa chinoratidza contrapositive chinova umboo hwechirevo chekutanga.
y-m-49-06.s.s1.r.c: Enzanisa kana chinyorwa ichi chakatora sehypothesis uye chakaratidza seconclusion zviri murongerwo wakafanana nehypothesis ne conclusion ye S.
y-m-49-06.s.s1.r.d: Iyi isarudzo yakaratidza chimiro cheumboo ne contradiction: kana mhedzisiro inopokana nefungidziro ikabuda, inoratidza kuti fungidziro yekutanga yakashata.
y-m-49-06.s.s1.explain: 나 akaratidza contrapositive ye S ('kana imwe chete kana kupfuura ndi even, saka ab ndi even'), uye 라 akaratidza ne contradiction. 가 ari kungotarisa mienzaniso, uye 다 akaratidza 'converse', apo hypothesis ne conclusion zvakatsiviwa.
y-m-49-06.s.s2.prompt: Tsanangura kuti nei chinyorwa 다 chisingaratidzi S uchishandisa mashoko 'hypothesis' ne 'conclusion', uye unyorewo kuti chinyorwa ichi chakaratidza chirevo chipi.
y-m-49-06.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora hypothesis ne conclusion ye S mutsara mumwe imwe neimwe, uye unyore mutsara wekutanga nemutsara wekupedzisira we 다 nenzira imwe chete.
y-m-49-06.s.s2.hint.1: Enzanisa hypothesis ne conclusion yemativi maviri.
y-m-49-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora chirevo chakaratidzwa ne 다 chaizvo se 'Kana a ne b zvose ndema odd, saka ab ndi odd' here?
y-m-49-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakanyorawo here kuti hypothesis ne conclusion ye S ndeapi?
y-m-49-06.s.s2.model.0: 다 yakaratidza 'Kana a ne b zvose ndema odd, saka ab ndi odd'. Iyi converse, ine hypothesis ne conclusion ye S dzakatsiviwa, saka hairatidzi kuti S yakarurama.
